title: Access Barrier to Fix Map
description: Five barriers families face, seven club practices that address them -- and the one barrier three fixes converge on.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Reaching Underserved Communities and Removing Barriers

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a barrier a family might face (cost, transportation, inflexible timing, language, or disability access), the learner examines which club practice from this chapter addresses it, and identifies practices that address more than one barrier.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any barrier or fix for what it is and what it addresses
pedagogical.assessment: Name a barrier and ask which fixes address it, and which fix removes it without the family asking.
